candidates.description: The Secret Garden (Huwon) at Changdeokgung Palace, once used for royal entertainment and ceremonies, is a significant heritage site showcasing traditional landscaping. Historically, it was off-limits to commoners, reserved only for the Joseon royal family. 오랜만에 들려 IWC매장에 방문하였다. 역시 👍 최고…
